name: Domain Cover via Local Tetrahedrizations
aliases: Localized approach to visualize scattered data
definition: An isosurface generation algorithm for large-scale volumetric scattered data that avoids global tessellation or resampling by defining a set of local tetrahedrizations guaranteed to cover the domain, applying point-based isosurface contouring inside each.
summary: Domain Cover via Local Tetrahedrizations generates isosurfaces from scattered data by constructing local tetrahedral meshes, avoiding global tessellation or resampling.
